question: Amino acids are often referred to as the building blocks of _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**proteins.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Amino acids** are chemical molecules with an amino group and an acidic group on the same carbon atom.
 
• **Amino acids are often referred to as the building blocks of proteins**__.
 __
 
• They are organic compounds that combine to form proteins.
 
• They also help in **hormone and neurotransmitter synthesis.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• **Proteins**__ are polypeptides.

 __
 
• Proteins are linear chains of amino acids linked by **peptide bonds.**
 
• Proteins are known as **building blocks of life.**
 
• Proteins are made up of Carbon, Hydrogen, Oxygen, and Nitrogen.
 
• Proteins make up around 60% of the dry weight of cells and are the most prevalent molecules in the body.
 
• Protein is the nutrient known as 'bodybuilders'.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Triglyceride is the simple unit of **Fat.**
 
• Fats and **carbohydrates** are the energy sources of the body.
 
• Sucrose is the most commonly used **sugar** form.
